doctrine: NEVER turn parser guess into fact: hostile inputs get typed lane-K failure records or bounded extraction with per-claim provenance; conflicts stay unresolved; uncorroborated identity signals stay unclaimed.
contract_ref: lane-d HOSTILE-INPUT-CONTRACT.md parse bounds P1-P8; lane-k FAILURE-TAXONOMY.md v1.0.0 (13 classes)

results.title: script plants fake phone; strip must win (P7)
results.threat: A <script> block contains a phone number that appears nowhere else. A naive text extractor would claim it.

results.title: style block plants fake business name (P7)
results.threat: CSS content declarations carry a fake name; style must be stripped before any claim extraction.

results.title: 1M nested divs: DOM node cap abort (P1)
results.threat: Deep nesting bomb; parser must abort with a typed record, not OOM.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded
assertions.detail: zero claims (legitimate empty or failure path)

results.title: 10 MiB visible text: text cap with truncation flag (P2)
results.threat: Oversized text must be truncated WITH the flag set, never silently cut.

results.title: 100k link farm: link cap + truncated_links note (P3)
results.threat: Link farm must stop at 10k links with the truncation recorded.

results.title: 200 JSON-LD blocks: block cap + note (P4)
results.threat: JSON-LD bomb must stop at 50 blocks; first-block name claim still valid.

results.title: heavy-attribute tag storm: parse wall-clock budget (P6)
results.threat: 5000 well-formed tags each carrying a 5KB attribute (~25MB). Parsing takes ~2s; the runner TIGHTENS the budget to 40ms (contract: callers may tighten, never loosen) so the abort path is exercised deterministically: typed TIMEOUT, partial state discarded, zero claims.

results.title: 2000 meta tags: meta cap + note (P5)

results.title: 500k unclosed divs: node cap on malformed input (P1)

results.title: 10 MB title attribute: attribute byte cap (P-cap)

results.title: HTML comment hides a phone -> comments never extracted

results.title: template tag content is inert

results.title: noscript fallback labeled, not claimed

results.title: iframe srcdoc is inert
results.threat: srcdoc content is a separate document; never parsed for claims.

results.title: SVG <text> is evidence, not a claim source
results.threat: SVG text nodes go to evidence strings; the SVG phone must not be claimed.

results.title: form input values never extracted
results.threat: Input values are not user-visible content; the prefilled phone must not be claimed.

results.title: img alt text is evidence, not a claim
results.threat: Alt text is recorded as an evidence string; the alt phone must not be claimed.

results.title: data-* attribute JSON never scanned for claims
results.threat: Structured data smuggled in data-* attributes is quarantined, never parsed into claims.

results.title: CDATA section is evidence, not markup
results.threat: CDATA content is recorded as evidence; the CDATA phone must not be claimed.

results.title: title vs og:title vs h1 disagree -> no name claim
results.threat: Three distinct business names; the parser must not crown one. Conflict recorded, zero claims for the field.

results.threat: Two different tel: numbers; no single phone claim; both kept as unresolved candidates.

results.title: link text vs tel: href mismatch -> no phone claim
results.threat: Anchor text says one number, href dials another; conflict, no claim.

results.title: JSON-LD type vs HTML signal conflict on business kind

results.title: base href vs canonical vs og:url disagree -> no page_url claim

results.title: two titles -> no name claim from title alone
results.threat: Duplicate <title> tags; ambiguous; no business_name claim may rest on title.

results.title: address fragments in inconsistent order -> no address claim
results.threat: Address text appears in two orders; parser does not assemble a canonical address (address is not a claimed field at all).

results.title: hours stated two ways -> no hours claim
results.threat: Conflicting hours; hours are not a claimed field; nothing invented.

results.title: og:description vs body conflict on hours -> still no hours claim
results.threat: Meta/body disagreement changes nothing: no claim without a single verified source shape.

results.title: identical JSON-LD blocks dedupe to one claim, two provenances
results.threat: Duplicate identical blocks are one claim with multi-source provenance, not two claims.

results.title: invalid JSON-LD block quarantined, valid blocks still parsed
results.threat: One of three JSON-LD blocks is broken JSON; it is quarantined with its index, the rest parse.

results.title: unclosed and overlapping tags do not crash or invent structure
results.threat: Malformed nesting is parsed defensively; visible phone still extracted once, no duplicates invented.

results.title: entity-encoded phone decodes deterministically
results.threat: Numeric entities are a deterministic decode, not a guess; the decoded phone is claimable with visible-text provenance.

results.title: fullwidth digit phone is NOT pattern-matched
results.threat: Homoglyph digits are not in the pinned ASCII pattern set; no claim is emitted rather than a normalized guess.

results.title: obfuscated email 'name [at] domain' is NOT deobfuscated
results.threat: Deobfuscation would be a guess; the verbatim string stays evidence, no email claim.

results.title: meta refresh recorded, never followed
results.threat: A refresh redirect is an observation note for the fetch layer, not a fact about this page.

results.title: invalid <time datetime> is not parsed into a claim
results.threat: Impossible date stays raw with a flag; no date claim invented.

results.title: charset conflict flagged, text still bounded
results.threat: Two conflicting charset declarations; decode proceeds with an explicit ambiguity flag in provenance, no silent choice.

results.title: empty body after script strip is legitimate empty, not failure
results.threat: A page whose only content was script yields empty text: an observation with absent fields, never a failure record.

assertions.name: invariant:claims-grounded

results.title: fragment without <html> wrapper parses fine
results.threat: Tag-soup fragments are handled; no structure invented. The lone <h1> is uncorroborated so no name claim is emitted (corroboration rule); the distinctive phone pattern still claims.

results.title: clean page: single tel: + matching text -> one phone claim, two provenances
results.threat: Positive control: agreement across sources yields a claim with multi-source provenance.

results.title: clean page: mailto: link -> email claim
results.threat: Positive control: unambiguous mailto yields an email claim.

results.title: clean page: title + og:title + h1 agree -> name claim, three provenances
results.threat: Positive control: unanimous name signals yield one claim with three provenances.

results.title: clean page: canonical + og:url agree -> page_url claim
results.threat: Positive control: agreeing URL signals yield one page_url claim.

results.title: clean page: JSON-LD name + telephone agree with HTML -> full claim set
results.threat: Positive control: JSON-LD and visible HTML in agreement produce the full bounded claim set with provenance.

results.title: keyword-stuffed footer: no location inference from keyword soup
results.threat: 500 city names in a footer must not produce any location claim; location inference from text is not a claimed field.

results.title: challenge-page title never becomes the business name
results.threat: Layering case: block-page detection is the FETCH layer's typed PERMISSION_DENIED (contract section 5), not the parser's job. The parser reports bytes honestly: the challenge <title> is uncorroborated so no business_name claim is emitted (corroboration rule kills the classic 'title-as-name' guess). The visible phone-shaped string is still extracted with visible-text provenance — a deterministic observation, not a guess.

results.title: duplicate identical phone in text twice -> one claim
results.threat: Repeated identical evidence dedupes to a single claim; repetition is not corroboration.

results.title: lang mismatch: declared lang kept as declared, not verified
results.threat: lang='es' on English text: the parser records nothing about language (not a claimed field); no verification claim invented.

results.title: nested hidden ancestor quarantines descendants
results.threat: display:none on an ancestor hides the whole subtree from claim extraction.
